verses.text: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
lines: Praise Yahweh!
Sing to Yahweh a new song,
his praise in the assembly of the saints.

verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
lines: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them.
Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.text: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
lines: Let them praise his name in the dance!
Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

verses.text: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
lines: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people.
He crowns the humble with salvation.

verses.text: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
lines: Let the saints rejoice in honor.
Let them sing for joy on their beds.

verses.text: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
lines: May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
and a two-edged sword in their hand,

verses.text: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
lines: to execute vengeance on the nations,
and punishments on the peoples;

verses.text: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
lines: to bind their kings with chains,
and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.text: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
lines: to execute on them the written judgment.
All his saints have this honor.
Praise Yah!
